context7.name: context7
context7.description: Live library documentation lookup. Resolves library names and fetches up-to-date API docs.

sequential-thinking.name: sequential-thinking
sequential-thinking.description: Step-by-step reasoning over a problem. BH invokes it for borderline verifier findings to surface implicit chains.

firecrawl.name: firecrawl
firecrawl.description: Fetches and converts URLs to markdown. BH uses it to verify external links referenced in README/docs.

playwright.name: playwright
playwright.description: Headless browser. BH uses it sparingly to verify JS-rendered web entry-points referenced in repo docs.
